name: Southern Publishing and Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Southern Publishing and Media Co.,Ltd. operates as a publishing company in China. It operates through six segments: Publishing; Distribution; Material Trading; Printing; Newspaper and Media; and Others. The company publishes and distributes books, newspapers, magazines, and electronic audio-visual publications. In addition, it is involved in the printed materials business, such as primary and secondary school textbooks, teaching aids, stationery, and general books; media business, such as digital publishing and mobile media, distribution, retail, printing material sales, and cross-media operation.
